title: Constable (General Duty / GD)
qualification: Class 8 Pass Certificate or Higher Recognized Qualification
salary: The advertised Constable GD posts carry Pay Level 3, with Grade Pay Rs. 1,800 under the specified pay-band structure of Rs. 5,200–20,200. || These are the pay particulars stated in the official advertisement and should not be confused with monthly in-hand salary.
age_limit: Applicants must be at least 18 years old and not more than 37 years old as on the date of the advertisement, 14 October 2026.
selection_process: Selection for the Constable GD posts involves physical and medical screening, outdoor physical efficiency tests, an objective-type written examination, interview and NCC certification assessment. || Candidates must qualify in the required physical and medical standards before participating in outdoor tests. Only candidates who qualify the PET will be called for the written examination.
